verdict.rationale: doola's registered-agent page publishes a flat annual price of $297 per year, which covers the published-price half of the story. It never explicitly states the renewal price up front, and the 'Signup ... for just $297' wording frames it as a signup price, so renewal at the same rate is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit renewal-price statement, confirmation the $297 is not introductory, independent corroboration of renewal billing.

support.subject: As a founder, registered-agent service has a published flat annual price, with the renewal price stated up front

citations.quote: Signup with doola for **just $297 per year**.
